summary: Master the art of leading through challenging times with our comprehensive training program. Build resilience and confidence in your leadership approach.
lede: Crisis leadership training prepares professionals responsible for organizational stability to guide teams through disruption and make decisions amid uncertainty. Participants practise classifying situations with the Cynefin framework, assessing business impacts, and planning crisis communications, while building decision logs and reviewing incidents to support continuity and recovery.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for maintaining organizational stability and leading teams through periods of significant change or disruption.
modules: High-Stakes Decision Making and Cognitive Bias
Strategic Crisis Communication and Stakeholder Trust
Building Resilient Teams and Psychological Safety
Digital Resilience and AI-Driven Crisis Monitoring
Operational Continuity and Supply Chain Resilience
Financial and Legal Safeguards during Uncertainty
Strategic Integration and the Resilience Roadmap
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in a management or specialist role. Familiarity with basic risk management concepts is recommended but not required. No specific software is needed, though access to a laptop for digital exercises is encouraged.
